verifiedAgainst.note: Every winget id and VS Code extension id below was resolved live on the verification date.

comment: Single source of truth for what a Power Platform agent workstation needs. Read by setup-workstation (installs), check-setup (diagnoses), scripts/install.js (bootstrap minimums) and scripts/watch/upstream-watch.js (staleness, version floors, and a weekly existence check of every package ID and URL parsed from the install commands below). This file is the machine-readable companion to shared/microsoft-refs.md — vendor mechanics live here and there, nowhere else.

items.name: Node.js LTS
items.why: Runs the agent CLIs and most Microsoft plugin MCP servers. Several Microsoft plugins require 22+; mobile-apps requires 24 LTS.

install.linux: Install via nvm: https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm then `nvm install 24`

items.after: Open a new terminal so PATH refreshes.

items.name: git
items.why: Agent runtimes clone plugin marketplaces with git; without it every marketplace add fails.

install.linux: sudo apt install git   (or your distro's package manager)

items.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
items.why: Agent runtime. Plugin marketplace commands need 1.0.71+.

install.all: npm install -g @github/copilot   (then run `copilot` once to sign in)

items.name: Claude Code
items.why: Agent runtime (alternative to Copilot CLI — one is enough).

items.name: .NET 10 SDK
items.why: Installs and runs pac, runs Microsoft's canvas authoring MCP server (dnx), and packages solutions.

items.name: Power Platform CLI (pac)
items.why: The backbone of every Power Platform agent workflow — auth, environments, solutions, PCF.

diagnose.match: You must install .NET to run this application
diagnose.meaning: .NET is installed outside its default folder (Homebrew formula, dotnet-install script), so the pac launcher can't find it.

repair.shim: pac install latest   (user-scoped, no admin — fixes an Intune/MSI shim on PATH with no CLI behind it)

dotnetRoot.posix: for f in ~/.zshrc ~/.bashrc; do grep -q DOTNET_ROOT "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 'export DOTNET_ROOT="$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v dotnet)")")"' >> "$f"; done   (persists DOTNET_ROOT for new terminals)

items.after: Open a new terminal so PATH refreshes.

items.name: Azure CLI
items.why: Most Microsoft Power Platform plugins (FlowAgent included) authenticate through `az login`.
items.managedDevice: Machine-wide MSI — a standard user gets UAC exit code 1602. Route to the IT request.

items.name: Python 3.12+
items.why: Microsoft's Dataverse skills run on the Dataverse Python SDK.

items.name: Dataverse Python SDK and auth libraries
items.why: Required by Microsoft's dv-* Dataverse skills (same package list as their dv-connect). On macOS/Linux the install is user-scoped: --break-system-packages only lets pip write to the user's own site-packages on an externally managed Python (Homebrew, Ubuntu 24.04+); the system Python's packages are untouched.

install.win: py -m pip install --upgrade azure-identity requests PowerPlatform-Dataverse-Client pandas msal msal-extensions
install.posix: python3 -m pip install --user --upgrade --break-system-packages azure-identity requests PowerPlatform-Dataverse-Client pandas msal msal-extensions

items.name: Microsoft Power Platform skills marketplace
items.why: The capability layer everything else sits on. Also distributes the Dataverse plugin.

items.name: Dataverse skills
items.runtimeNote: Claude Code fails to clone the shorthand git-subdir source in Microsoft's marketplace entry on machines without a GitHub SSH key; Anthropic's official marketplace lists the same Microsoft plugin with a full HTTPS URL.
items.why: Schema, data, query, solution and security operations for Dataverse — used by nearly every build.

items.name: Anthropic official plugin marketplace (Claude Code only)
PCF code components (Microsoft, preview)
items.why: Builds, tests, diagnoses, upgrades, deploys and verifies PCF controls from Microsoft-maintained templates. Needs Node 20+; pac and .NET to deploy; Azure CLI to verify.

items.name: Copilot Studio authoring (GitHub Copilot harness agents)
items.why: Create, edit, validate and test harness agents, and migrate classic agents to the harness. Needs pac 2.9.3+ (the manifest's pac floor already covers it).

items.name: Copilot Studio VS Code extension
items.why: Microsoft's Copilot Studio skills depend on it (language server, validation).

install.mac: Install from the Mac App Store, then `sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app`

items.name: Microsoft Learn MCP server
items.why: Lets every skill verify against live Microsoft documentation instead of memory.

install.claude: claude mcp add --transport http microsoft-learn https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp

items.note: Remote, no auth. A plain browser fetch returns 405 — that means alive. Skip registering if any installed plugin already bundles it.

items.name: Playwright MCP (browser automation)
items.why: Lets the agent drive a browser to test what it built.
items.note: Skip registering if model-apps or power-pages is installed — they bundle it.

items.name: pac CLI built-in MCP server

install.run: pac copilot mcp --run   (zero-install alt: dnx Microsoft.PowerApps.CLI.Tool --yes copilot mcp --run)
install.claude: Use the `claude mcp add-json pac-cli …` registration Microsoft publishes: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/developer/howto/use-mcp

items.note: Microsoft frames it as for local development and testing.

items.name: Power Platform Tools VS Code extension
Power CAT skills marketplace
items.why: Architecture advisor, flow and Pages review, governance — advisory layer from Microsoft's Customer Advisory Team.

retired.replacedBy: Microsoft's power-automate plugin builds, edits and debugs flows directly. The flow lessons moved to the conventions plugin (flow-conventions).
retired.action: Uninstall it from every runtime; make sure conventions is installed.

retired.replacedBy: Microsoft's pcf plugin builds, tests, deploys and verifies PCF controls. The PCF judgement (is PCF the right tool, licensing, gotchas) moved to the conventions plugin (pcf-conventions).
retired.action: Uninstall it from every runtime; make sure conventions and Microsoft's pcf plugin are installed.

variants.question: Which kind of Copilot Studio agents — standard, GitHub Copilot harness, or both?

harness.label: GitHub Copilot harness agents (and migrating classic agents to them)
